ingredients.ghee-dough: Ghee (for the dough mixture): one teaspoon
ingredients.ghee-coat: Ghee (to smear around the kneaded dough): one teaspoon
ingredients.cooking-fat: Ghee or oil for cooking the holige: no quantity given

actions.grated: Grate the apple and keep it aside
actions.hot-ghee: Put one tablespoon of ghee in a pan and heat it
actions.sauteed: Add the grated apple to the hot ghee and sauté
actions.cardamom-added: When the sugar melts and begins to thicken, add the cardamom powder
actions.khova-added: Add the crumbled khoa and mix well
actions.cooling: When the mixture thickens and reaches a consistency for making balls, take it off the stove, put it on a plate and let it cool
actions.dough-mix: Put the maida in a bowl, add the turmeric, one teaspoon of ghee and the salt, and mix
actions.kneaded: Add water to this mixture little by little and knead it softer than chapati dough
actions.dough: Then smear one teaspoon of ghee around the kneaded dough and keep it covered for one to two hours (dough)
actions.stuffed: Now take dough equal in size to the prepared filling. Flatten the dough, put the filling inside and close it
actions.cooked: Once the tava is hot, smear it with ghee or oil and cook the holige on both sides
actions.serve: Enjoy the delicious holige with ghee and milk

ingredients.seed: Jackfruit seeds, boiled and powdered: 1 bowl
ingredients.water-dough: Water (for the dough): mentioned in the method; no quantity given

actions.filling-heated: Add the jackfruit seed powder, jaggery and grated coconut, add two spoons of water, put it on the stove and stir
actions.filling: Add the ghee and cardamom powder, stir, and take it off once it thickens a little. The filling is ready.
actions.dough-mix: Add the chiroti rava, wheat flour, turmeric and salt, add water and knead like chapati dough
actions.dough: Add 3 spoons of oil, knead, and keep it covered for two hours. The dough is ready.
actions.stuffed: Take a little dough, flatten it in your hand, place a ball of filling in the middle and close it
actions.rolled: Place it on the holige sheet and roll it out
actions.cooked: Put it on a hot tava, cook on both sides on a low flame and take it off

ingredients.salt: Salt: a pinch (mentioned in the method; not in the list)
ingredients.water: Water: mentioned in the method; no quantity given
ingredients.banana-leaf: Banana leaf: mentioned in the method; no quantity given

actions.hot-ghee: Heat the ghee in a pan
actions.beet-cooked: Add the grated beetroot and cook
actions.filling: Then add the dry coconut powder, powdered sugar and cardamom powder, mix well and take it off the stove
actions.dough: Add the chiroti rava, oil, a pinch of salt and water to the maida and knead to a chapati dough consistency
actions.flattened: Make small balls from this and flatten them on your palm into a puri shape
actions.stuffed: Place the filling in the middle
actions.rolled: Roll it out gently on a banana leaf smeared with oil
actions.cooked: Smear with ghee, put it on a hot griddle and cook both sides

ingredients.coconut: Grated dry coconut: 1 cup (grated and powdered)
ingredients.maida-filling: Maida (for the filling, to roast): 2 spoons
ingredients.ghee-dough: Ghee (for the dough): half a spoon
ingredients.oil-soak: Oil (for soaking): mentioned in the method; no quantity given
ingredients.hot-water: Hot water: a little at a time (mentioned in the method)
ingredients.water-sprinkle: Water (to sprinkle): mentioned in the method; no quantity given

actions.sugar-powdered: Grind the sugar finely and put it in a bowl
actions.mix-1: Add the sugar, grated coconut, cardamom powder and nutmeg powder and mix
actions.maida-roasted: In another vessel, roast 2 spoons of maida
actions.mix-2: Add it to that and mix
actions.ghee-melted: Heat the pan again, add 2 spoons of ghee and melt it
actions.mix-3: Mix it into the sugar and coconut mixture
actions.filling: Add a little milk and bind it into balls (filling)
actions.dough-first: In a vessel, add the maida, chiroti rava, a pinch of salt, half a spoon of ghee and hot water a little at a time, and prepare the dough
actions.rest-1: Keep it covered for half an hour
actions.kneaded: After half an hour, sprinkle water on the prepared dough and knead it
actions.dough: Add one spoon of oil to the dough, knead again and leave it for 2 minutes
actions.flattened: Make a ball from the dough and flatten it to the size of your palm
actions.stuffed: Place a ball of filling inside it and fold it around
actions.cooked: Once the griddle is hot, cook on both sides

ingredients.water-dough: Water (for the dough): mentioned in the method; quantity: a little

actions.blended: Add the mango pulp to it and grind for one round
actions.filling-heated: Add the jaggery, a pinch of salt and the cardamom powder, put it on the stove, add 1 spoon of water and stir
actions.filling: Take it off when it thickens. The filling is ready.
actions.dough-mix: Add the wheat flour, chiroti rava, salt and turmeric, add a little water and mix; it should be of chapati dough consistency
actions.dough: Add oil, knead and keep it covered for 2 hours. The dough is ready.
actions.stuffed: Take a little dough, flatten it in your hand, place a ball of filling and close it
actions.rolled: Roll it out on the holige sheet
actions.cooked: Put it on a hot tava, cook on a low flame and take it off

ingredients.water-dough: Water (for the dough): mentioned in the method; quantity: a little

actions.ground: Grind the poppy seeds and grated coconut together finely
actions.filling-heated: Put it in a thick-bottomed vessel, add the jaggery and cardamom powder, add two spoons of water, put it on the stove and stir
actions.filling: Take it off once it thickens. The filling is ready. Make sure no moisture is left in the filling.
actions.dough-mix: Add the chiroti rava, wheat flour, a little salt and turmeric, add a little water and knead like chapati dough
actions.dough: Add three spoons of oil, knead and keep it covered for two hours. The softer the dough, the easier it is to pat out the holige.
actions.stuffed: Fill the dough with the filling as with the other holige
actions.cooked: Take it off the griddle when the aroma of the dry coconut spreads

ingredients.oil-sheet: Oil (to apply on the holige sheet): mentioned in the method; no quantity given
ingredients.water-dough: Water (for the dough): mentioned in the method; quantity: a little

actions.dal-powder: Roast the moong dal until its colour changes slightly and grind it finely
actions.mix: Put both in a vessel, add the ghee and mix
actions.filling: Add the milk and make it soft. The filling is ready.
actions.dough-mix: Add the chiroti rava, wheat flour, a little salt and turmeric, add a little water and knead like chapati dough
actions.dough: Add three spoons of oil, knead and keep it covered for two hours. The dough is ready.
actions.stuffed: Pat the dough out flat in your hand, place a ball of filling and close it
actions.rolled: Apply oil on the holige sheet, place the stuffed ball and roll it out
actions.cooked: Put it on a hot tava, cook on a low flame and take it off

ingredients.oil-sheet: Oil (to apply on the holige sheet): mentioned in the method; no quantity given
ingredients.water-dough: Water (for the dough): mentioned in the method; quantity: a little

actions.filling: In a vessel, add the grated paneer, khoa, powdered sugar and cardamom powder and mix well. The filling is ready.
actions.dough-mix: Add the chiroti rava, wheat flour, a little salt and turmeric, add a little water and knead like chapati dough
actions.dough: Add three spoons of oil, knead and keep it covered for two hours. The dough is ready.
actions.stuffed: Flatten the dough, fill it with the filling, and fold the dough in like petals of a flower to make a ball
actions.rolled: Apply oil on the holige sheet and roll this out. Make sure the edges are thin.
actions.cooked: Cook as with the other holige

ingredients.ghee-roast: Ghee (to roast the wheat flour): one spoon
ingredients.ghee-khova: Ghee (to fry the khoa): one spoon
ingredients.water-dough: Water (for the dough): mentioned in the method; quantity: a little

actions.hot-ghee-1: Place a thick-bottomed vessel on the stove and, once it is hot, add one spoon of ghee
actions.wheat-roasted: Add the wheat flour, roast until the aroma comes, and set it aside
actions.khova-fried: In the same vessel add one spoon of ghee, add the khoa and stir
actions.jaggery-added: Add the jaggery and cardamom powder, stir and fry
actions.filling: Add the wheat flour, stir well and take it off once it thickens a little. The filling is ready.
actions.dough-mix: Add the chiroti rava, wheat flour, a little salt and turmeric, add a little water and knead like chapati dough
actions.dough: Add three spoons of oil, knead and keep it covered for two hours. The dough is ready.
actions.stuffed: When placing the khoa inside the dough, it must be placed in the shape of a ball. Otherwise, the filling will not reach the edges when rolling.
actions.rolled: Watch this carefully and roll it out
actions.cooked: Put it on a hot griddle and cook on a low flame

ingredients.sesame: White sesame seeds: 2 large spoons each
ingredients.copra: Grated dry coconut: 2 large spoons each
ingredients.wheat-filling: Wheat flour (for the filling): 1 spoon each
ingredients.jaggery: Jaggery powder: as much as needed to taste
ingredients.water-syrup: Water (for the syrup): just a little (mentioned in the method)

actions.dough-mix: Add the maida, rava, turmeric, salt and ghee, knead softly like chapati dough and prepare the dough
actions.dough-rested: Add a little oil and leave it to soak for half an hour
actions.roasted-seeds: Roast the peanuts, white sesame seeds and poppy seeds to the right level
actions.powder: Once cooled, combine everything with the roasted gram and grated dry coconut and grind finely
actions.powder-flours: Add the roasted wheat flour and rice flour to it
actions.syrup: Take as much jaggery as there is powder, add just a little water and put it on the stove
actions.filling-mix: Once a thin syrup forms, add the prepared powder. Stir well without lumps to prepare the filling, and turn off the stove
actions.filling: Add the cardamom powder and 1 spoon of ghee
actions.dough: Knead the prepared dough well once more
actions.stuffed: Take a lemon-sized portion of filling and stuff it into the dough
actions.rolled: Apply oil on the holige paper and pat it out thin or roll it out
actions.cooked: Put oil on the tava and cook the rolled holige on both sides until crisp
actions.serve: Enjoy with ghee. This holige can be kept for eight days.
